Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and began a left turn when the
vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 1
stated the impact pushed the vehicle sideways and that the driver's wrist struck the steering wheel and door frame.
Driver 2 confirmed the sequence of events at the scene and did not dispute how the collision occurred. Two
independent witnesses gave statements consistent with Driver 1 and Driver 2, and photographs taken at the scene
show damage to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle and the front of Driver 2's vehicle, which is consistent with a
broadside impact of this type. The Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time and was observed by responding
officers and witnesses. Officers found no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle in the area of impact, and Driver 1 is
listed as a named driver on the policy. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture and was transported for treatment.
</page>
